events.description: Phase 1 is docs-only — Design folder canonicalisation (Age_1_Alanthor.md + Overview.md) MUST land before any code, per CLAUDE.md mandate 'Do not introduce new mechanics, balance values, or design changes without updating the Design folder first.' Acceptance criterion enforces zero .cs / .json / .unity / .prefab file changes in the Phase 1 commit.

Confirmed: the BFME2 hub/segment/instance architecture is already 80% built (AlanthorWall.cs has CreateHub/CreateSegment/CreateInstance; WallUpgradeSystem converts instances to towers/gates; WallSegmentCleanupSystem cascades on death; WallEnclosureIncomeSystem detects closed compartments; chain-placement in BuildCommandPannel.cs works for adjacent placements). The four gaps are: (a) hut age-up choice UI doesn't exist (task-066 stub), (b) builder UI contract that 'only hubs may be placed directly' is implicit not documented, (c) auto-segment formation is placement-time only, not retroactive on hub completion, (d) gate is per-2m-instance, needs to be 5-instance-wide (~10m) for battalion throughput. UI Toolkit ActionPanelRegion.cs:14 explicitly says WallInstanceUpgrade renders buttons but click handler logs TODO — that wiring is missing.

Superseding scope: task-066's Alanthor branch (auto-fortify-radius around each hut on age-up) is replaced by this task's player-choice mechanic (each hut offers Convert to Wall Hub / Convert to Watch Tower). The existing Age_1_Alanthor 'Gatherer's Hut' section must be rewritten in Phase 1. Runai and Feraldis branches of task-066 are untouched.

Builder UI contract for Alanthor wall primitives: Alanthor_Wall (= the hub) and Alanthor_Tower (= standalone Watch Tower) are the ONLY directly-buildable wall-related entries. Alanthor_WallTower and Alanthor_WallGate stay out of BuildableBuildings — they are conversion-only via per-segment UI. This resolves the audit row from task-082 §B (WallTower/WallGate are conversion-only by design, not buildable). task-091's hashset work explicitly does not include them — no conflict.

Surfaced 10 open design questions (hub spacing, instance-count formula, HP/cost balance, snap-vs-reject, segment-selection UX, group-toggle vs independent gate, hub death grace period, AI wall strategy, visual prefab strategy, conversion timer/builder semantics) that Phase 1 must resolve to canonical values or explicit playtest-placeholder defaults. Without these the implementer cannot autopilot through ambiguity.

AI integration deferred (R9 / Open Q8 / Phase 7 minimum bar). Alanthor AI does NOT build walls in this task; the dead [DisableAutoCreation] code in AIEconomyManager.cs:627-756 stays dead. Phase 7 only verifies SimpleAISystem does not crash on Alanthor walls and that retroactive auto-segment formation is lockstep-deterministic (sort hub pairs by Entity.Index).

7-phase plan with all phases producing artifacts (no verification-only phases). Phase 1: Design docs (docs-only). Phase 2: Hut age-up choice UI. Phase 3: Builder UI contract verification + assertion. Phase 4: WallAutoSegmentSystem for retroactive formation. Phase 5: 5-instance gate region (segment-level conversion). Phase 6: Live UI Toolkit click wiring for segment-conversion. Phase 7: Pathfinding + AI safety + scenario test update.

UI/UX spec authored (task.md § UI / UX Specification). Hut age-up choice surfaces in the existing UI-Toolkit ACTIONS panel via a new ActionType.GathererHutAgeUpChoice → two large ActionCells (castle/eye glyphs, tone=build) with live cost chips and aria-labels; no floating world-space prompt. Builder catalog keeps Alanthor_Wall (renamed 'Wall Hub') + Alanthor_Tower as the only Alanthor wall-related cards; Alanthor_WallTower / Alanthor_WallGate stay conversion-only. Auto-segment formation gets a silent default + a 500 ms construction-shimmer particle + low-volume SFX, both reduced-motion-guarded. Segment→Gate conversion resolves click-on-instance to the parent segment, surfaces 'Convert to Gate (5×)' as a single large ActionCell with a hover-preview bridge topic that highlights the 5 candidate instances world-space; short segments (< 5) show 'Gate (N×)' + amber warning glyph and remain enabled. Wall-network selection: hub click → hub; instance click → parent segment; drag-select aggregates individuals (no whole-network select in v1). Gate state is automatic-only (read-only OPEN/CLOSED pip; manual toggle deferred). Health bars: hub + instance keep their standard floating bars; selected segment / gate-region shows ONE aggregated bar in Selection.jsx (sum of WallInstanceRef HP / HpMax, with intact-count sub-text). Zero new theme tokens; all chrome reuses jade-theme variables already in Selection.jsx / Actions.jsx. Six new open UX questions added (cancel mid-conversion, network-select, friendly-right-click, manual gate toggle, attention-pulse persistence, hover-preview cost overlay) for Phase 1 to resolve.

AD-1: 7-phase plan locked, Phase 1 docs-only. Phase 1 (docs) → Phase 2 (hut age-up choice cluster: GathererHutAgeUpChoice marker + GathererHutConverting timer + ConvertHutCommand triad + HutConversionSystem + ActionType.GathererHutAgeUpChoice extractor + ActionPanelRegion dispatch case) → Phase 3 (BuildableBuildings boot-assert that Alanthor_WallTower/WallGate are NOT directly buildable + JSX Wall→Wall Hub relabel) → Phase 4 (WallAutoSegmentSystem with cached _hubQuery, deterministic sorted hub-pair iteration, AlanthorWall.AreHubsConnected guard) → Phase 5 (5-instance gate region: WallGateRegionTag + WallGateGroup leader + WallSegmentUpgradeState segment-level timer + AlanthorWall.PickGateRegionInstances + WallUpgradeSystem second loop + WallGatePassabilitySystem RegionDetectRadius 6.0) → Phase 6 (ConvertSegmentToGateCommand triad + ActionPanelRegion WallInstanceUpgrade dispatch + HudBridge wall:previewGate inbound + WallInstancePreviewTag presentation-only) → Phase 7 (SimpleAISystem WallHubTag/WallSegmentTag/WallInstanceTag skip filters + ScenarioSetup SpawnWallSiege seeds a 5-wide gate + NavMesh rebake verification + AIEconomyManager.cs:627 task-109 comment).

AD-2: ConvertHutCommand wire payload uses HutConversionTarget (byte enum: None=0, WallHub=1, WatchTower=2) packed into the existing LockstepCommand.TargetEntityId int field. No new floats on the wire (mistakes.md F2-precision rule satisfied by construction). Pattern mirrors CancelTrainCommand exactly: ConvertHutCommand struct (marker for symmetry) + ConvertHutCommandHelper.Execute(em, hut, target) + CommandRouter.IssueConvertHut(em, hut, target, source) with em.Exists + HasComponent<GathererHutAgeUpChoice> + NotControllableTag guard triad + QueueConvertHutForLockstep partial + LockstepCommandType.ConvertHut=21 + LockstepManager dispatcher case.

AD-3: WallAutoSegmentSystem at 0.5s poll interval with cached _hubQuery in OnCreate (None=UnderConstruction filter — only completed hubs participate). No per-faction cache; full N² pair iteration sorted by (Entity.Index, Entity.Version) is trivially cheap up to ~100 hubs/faction (435 pair checks at 30 hubs ≈ 870 ops/sec). Lockstep determinism via deterministic sorted iteration before any structural change. Reuses AlanthorWall.CreateSegment unchanged. Roster-change cache invalidation deferred — premature optimisation. AlanthorWall.AreHubsConnected helper added for the 'already-linked' guard (walks the smaller of HubA's or HubB's WallHubLink buffer).

AD-4: 5-instance gate region modelled via per-instance WallGateRegionTag + shared WallGateGroup { Entity Leader } marker. Independent-per-instance gate toggle in WallGatePassabilitySystem retained (minimum-code path); RegionDetectRadius bumped from 3.0 to 6.0 for region members so all 5 cells open in unison when a battalion approaches from either end. Legacy 1-instance gates (no WallGateRegionTag) keep the 3.0 radius unchanged. WallSegmentUpgradeState (segment-level timer) replaces the per-instance WallUpgradeState for the Convert-to-Gate path; per-instance WallUpgradeState stays for the Convert-to-Tower path. AlanthorWall.PickGateRegionInstances handles cap-at-segment-length when segment has < 5 instances.

AD-5: Two new lockstep command slots: ConvertHut=21 and ConvertSegmentToGate=22 (verified free against LockstepTypes.cs:42 where CancelTrain=20 is the highest occupied). Both wire payloads use int fields only — ConvertHut packs the byte enum target in TargetEntityId; ConvertSegmentToGate packs the focusInstance network-id in TargetEntityId (0 = no focus → fallback to segment midpoint). AlanthorWall.CreateSegment/CreateInstance must add NetworkedEntity (NetworkIdGenerator.GetNextId) so segments/instances can be addressed by lockstep payloads — currently they do not. This is a 2-line change added either in Phase 4 or Phase 6, whichever phase lands first.

AD-6: AI integration deferred to Phase 7 verification only — no new AI logic for walls. SimpleAISystem gets explicit `if (em.HasComponent<WallHubTag>(building)) continue;` skip filters in its build-target / repair-target / attack-target enumerators, so future AI changes do not accidentally try to construct hubs via the SimpleAI path. AIEconomyManager.cs:627-756 dead wall-building block stays dead with a task-109 comment marker. AIAlanthorEndgameSystem remains [DisableAutoCreation] per project-facts.md. Alanthor AI building walls strategically is a follow-up task that depends on this task's primitives.

AD-7: Aggregated Health bar on gate / segment selection computed on the JSX side from the WallInstanceRef buffer's HP sum, not stored on the segment entity (segments currently carry placeholder Health{1,1}). Selection.jsx StatBar fed via a new aggregated field on the selection payload (`segmentHpAggregate: { value, max, intactCount, totalCount }` emitted by HudBridge.EmitSingle when selection is a segment or gate region). Per-instance world-space floating Health bars remain unchanged — they already render via the existing FloatingHealthBars Health-component path. Bar refresh is O(N≤50) per panel refresh at 0.25 Hz; negligible cost.

events.title: Design folder canonicalisation (DOCS ONLY)
events.notes: Docs-only edits to docs/Design/Age_1_Alanthor.md (+275 lines) and docs/Design/Overview.md (1 row rewritten). Zero .cs / .json / .unity / .prefab / .jsx files modified in this phase. All 16 open design questions resolved to canonical values or explicit PLAYTEST PLACEHOLDER defaults. Key resolutions: MaxAutoSegmentDistance=16m, segment-instance-spacing=2m linear, Wall Hub HP=400, instance HP=80, gate total HP=400 (5×80), Watch Tower HP=250 (corrected from legacy 950), Wall Hub cost=60S+40I, Gate conversion cost=80S flat, Watch Tower hut-conversion cost=40S+30I, hub-conversion timer=5s, tower-conversion timer=5s (hut path) / 10s (instance path), segment→gate timer=8s, no builder required for conversion, no cancel mid-conversion, AI does not build walls v1, gate state is automatic-only (no manual toggle), wall-network click selects single piece (drag-select aggregates), aggregated health bar on segment/gate via WallInstanceRef sum, silent + 500ms shimmer auto-segment feedback, hover-preview highlights 5 candidate instances world-space. New canonical section: ## Wall System (BFME2 hub-and-segment) with Overview, Wall Hub, Wall Segment, Wall Instance, Gate, Wall Tower, Watch Tower, Gatherer's Hut Age-Up Choice cross-link, Hub destruction cascade, Auto-segment formation feedback, Health bar treatment, AI Behaviour, Open Items / Playtest Placeholders, Cross-references subsections. Both retired sections (Gatherer's Hut → wall-segment anchor; flat Alanthor Wall/Wall Tower/Wall Gate stat blocks) carry explicit 'Superseded by task-109 (2026-05-21)' callouts at their top.

events.title: WallAutoSegmentSystem (retroactive auto-segment formation)
events.notes: New file Assets/Scripts/Systems/Buildings/WallAutoSegmentSystem.cs: SimulationSystemGroup ISystem under namespace TheWaningBorder.Systems.Buildings, [UpdateAfter(typeof(WallSegmentCleanupSystem))]. Cached EntityQuery built in OnCreate via state.GetEntityQuery(new EntityQueryDesc { All = WallHubTag + LocalTransform + FactionTag, None = UnderConstruction }). 0.5s poll cadence via _timer field (matches WallSegmentCleanupSystem). MaxAutoSegmentDistance = 16f public const, MaxAutoSegmentDistanceSq private const, squared-distance check uses `> MaxAutoSegmentDistanceSq` so the boundary at exactly 16m is inclusive. Snapshot-then-mutate: ToEntityArray → in-place insertion sort by (Entity.Index, Entity.Version) → NativeArray<float3> positions + NativeArray<Faction> factionIds populated by explicit GetComponentData lookups (because we sorted the entity array independently of the query's internal order) → NativeList<HubPair> snapshot collected with same-faction + squared-distance + AlanthorWall.AreHubsConnected guards → after the pair loop closes, CreateSegment is called for each pair with em.Exists belt-and-braces guards + a second AreHubsConnected re-check (the same A-B pair never appears twice in the snapshot, but the second check documents intent for cluster-of-3+ hub scenarios). All Native* allocators are Allocator.Temp and Dispose()'d explicitly. Helpers used: AlanthorWall.AreHubsConnected (already added in pre-Phase 4 file edits) walks WallHubLink buffer on hubA. AlanthorWall.CreateSegment (existing, unchanged): creates the WallSegmentTag entity, adds NetworkedEntity via NetworkIdGenerator.GetNextId (already present at line 139), updates both hubs' WallHubLink buffers, then SpawnInstances which calls CreateInstance for each wall piece (also adds NetworkedEntity at line 252). No SpawnSegmentBetweenHubs alias needed — CreateSegment is the canonical helper and is reused unchanged. Per-frame CreateEntityQuery: NONE (cached _hubQuery). Determinism: in-place insertion sort by (Entity.Index, Entity.Version), then deterministic nested for-pair iteration — confirmed. NetworkedEntity adds on segments + instances: already in place from pre-Phase 4 file (AlanthorWall.cs:139, 252).

events.title: 5-instance gate region (segment-level conversion)
events.notes:
Added 5 new ECS types to BuildingComponents.cs under a '5-instance Gate Region (task-109 phase 5)' banner: WallGateRegionTag (marker on each of the 5 instances), WallGateGroup { Entity Leader } (shared group identifier — every member of the same region carries the same Leader value; em.Exists(Leader) is the membership check, no separate int counter needed for lockstep determinism), WallInstancePreviewTag (presentation-only marker for the Phase 6 hover-preview rim), WallSegmentFocus { Entity Instance } (stored on the SEGMENT entity, references the wall INSTANCE the player right-clicked — used by Phase 6 to pick the 5-region centre; defaults to segment midpoint if absent), and WallSegmentUpgradeState { byte UpgradeType, Entity FocusInstance, float Total, float Remaining } (segment-level timer distinct from the per-instance WallUpgradeState — the segment entity gets this when the player commits 'Convert to Gate (5×)'). Used Total/Remaining naming (not Duration/Remaining) to match the spec's `Total = 8.0f per design` field; save-load (task-096) should serialize Remaining so save-during-conversion resumes correctly. Field name on WallSegmentFocus is `Instance` (not `Segment`) — aligns with Phase 6's `em.AddComponentData(segment, new WallSegmentFocus { Instance = inst })` and avoids the semantic oddity of a component on a segment back-referencing itself. AlanthorWall.cs gains NativeList<Entity> PickGateRegionInstances(em, segment, focusInstance, allocator): walks the segment's WallInstanceRef buffer, finds the focus index (defaults to buffer midpoint when focusInstance == Entity.Null or not found), and returns a 5-wide window centred on it with re-anchor logic for the boundary cases. Short-segment clamp: when refs.Length <= 5 returns ALL live instances unconditionally (every segment with at least one alive instance can become a gate). Added `using Unity.Collections;` for the NativeList<Entity>/Allocator types. WallUpgradeSystem.cs grows a SECOND foreach loop (Loop 2) after the existing per-instance loop: pendingSegments NativeList snapshot of every segment with `Remaining <= 0f`, then a follow-on pass that reads PickGateRegionInstances, picks members[members.Length / 2] as the Leader, and ecb.AddComponent's WallGateTag + WallGateRegionTag + WallGateGroup + WallGateState + new PresentationId{GatePresentationID} per member. Snapshot-then-mutate: members NativeList is read BEFORE any structural change; ecb.Playback and PresentationSpawnSystem.ForceRespawn happen AFTER the foreach scope closes. Loop 1 (per-instance Tower / legacy single-instance Gate via WallUpgradeState) stays unchanged — backward compatibility for pre-task-109 saves and the IMGUI reference panel (EntityActionPanel.cs:1641-1681). The new Loop 2 also clears any stale WallSegmentFocus on completion. WallGatePassabilitySystem.cs gains `private const float RegionDetectRadius = 6.0f` and a per-gate branch: `float radius = state.EntityManager.HasComponent<WallGateRegionTag>(entity) ? RegionDetectRadius : FriendlyDetectRadius;`. Legacy 1-instance gates without WallGateRegionTag keep the 3.0 radius. Only the friendly check uses this radius; enemy-side blocking via factionTag.Value mismatch is unchanged so enemies still cannot path through open friendly gates. EntityExtractors.GetDisplayInfo.cs gains an aggregated Health bar branch immediately after the standard Health block: when entity is WallSegmentTag with a WallInstanceRef buffer, sumHp / sumMax are computed across living instances and override info.CurrentHealth / info.MaxHealth. Description gains '{alive} / {total} intact' sub-text. Guard: only override when sumMax > 0 so an empty buffer doesn't render as 0/0 'fully depleted'. Per-instance world-space floating bars (FloatingHealthBars) continue unchanged — this only affects the Selection-panel aggregate.

Segment-instance buffer structure confirmed: WallInstanceRef (IBufferElementData) lives on the SEGMENT entity, populated by AlanthorWall.SpawnInstances during CreateSegment. Each entry holds the child instance entity. PickGateRegionInstances reads this buffer.

Short-segment clamp confirmed: refs.Length <= 5 short-circuits to 'return every live instance'. The leader picks `members[members.Length / 2]` so 1-instance returns [0]=leader; 2-instance returns members[1] as leader; 3 → members[1]; 4 → members[2]; 5 → members[2]. All cases produce a valid em.Exists(leader).

WallGatePassabilitySystem branch confirmed: only the radius widens for WallGateRegionTag members; the friendly faction filter is preserved untouched so enemy-side blocking is unaffected. Per-instance independent toggle retained (AD-4 minimum-code path).

Files modified: Assets/Scripts/Core/Components/BuildingComponents.cs (+5 types), Assets/Scripts/Entities/Buildings/AlanthorWall.cs (+PickGateRegionInstances helper +using Unity.Collections), Assets/Scripts/Systems/Buildings/WallUpgradeSystem.cs (+Loop 2 segment-level), Assets/Scripts/Systems/Buildings/WallGatePassabilitySystem.cs (+RegionDetectRadius branch), Assets/Scripts/UI/Panels/EntityExtractors.cs (+segment-aggregate health override).

Save/load impact for task-096: 5 new components serialize as standard IComponentData. WallSegmentUpgradeState.Remaining is mid-conversion timer — save-load should serialize so a save-during-conversion resumes correctly. WallGateGroup.Leader and WallSegmentFocus.Instance are Entity references — serialization needs the NetworkedEntity remapping pass like other Entity-bearing components.

Out of scope for Phase 5 and deferred to Phase 6: UI Toolkit click wiring for ActionType.WallInstanceUpgrade, ConvertSegmentToGateCommand triad, HudBridge wall:previewGate topic, JSX changes, hover-preview rim rendering via WallInstancePreviewTag.

events.title: Live UI Toolkit click wiring + hover preview

events.description: Phase 6 / AD-8: ConvertSegmentToGateCommand carries the canonical 80-supplies flat conversion cost (Phase 1 / Open Q3 resolution) as a public static readonly Cost on the helper class — the legacy BuildCosts.cs entry for Alanthor_WallGate (40 supplies + 15 iron) was per-instance and remains in place so the IMGUI EntityActionPanel reference (line 1641-1681) keeps working without BuildCosts churn. UI extractor + JSX fallback both read the helper's canonical value via ConvertSegmentToGateCommandHelper.ConversionCost so the live cost chip matches what gets charged on click.

Phase 6 / AD-9: Wall instance selection emits an action payload (ActionType.WallInstanceUpgrade) with TWO buttons — WallSegmentToGate (segment-level, 80s, 8s timer) and WallInstanceToTower (per-instance legacy, 60s+30i, 10s timer). The Gate button drops out while the parent segment already carries WallSegmentUpgradeState (no double-charge). Short segments (instance count < 5) still allow Gate but the label changes to 'Convert to Gate (Nx)' and a SHORT amber line appears in the Selection panel via the new 'wall' payload field.

Phase 6 / AD-10: The Tower per-instance conversion in the React HUD click handler is a no-op — the React panel's WallInstanceToTower button falls through to the C#-side ActionPanelRegion DispatchWallInstanceUpgrade case which handles the legacy WallUpgradeState path natively (mirrors IMGUI EntityActionPanel.cs:1641-1660). The Gate path goes through the React HUD via actions:convertWallSegmentToGate so the lockstep queue sees it; the Tower path stays in the in-game UIToolkit since it predates the React migration and doesn't need a JSX intermediary. Both buttons render in BOTH panels (React HUD + in-game UIToolkit) for consistency; the Tower button just dispatches differently per surface.

Phase 6 / AD-11: Hover preview routes through a new wall:previewGate bridge topic carrying {segmentId, focusInstanceId, on}. HandleWallPreviewGate resolves the segment via WallInstanceParent (focus instance → parent segment) and toggles WallInstancePreviewTag on the 5 candidate instances via AlanthorWall.PickGateRegionInstances (Phase 5 helper). Pure local-client state — no lockstep involvement. The presentation system can later read WallInstancePreviewTag to rim those instances with the accent colour; until that ships the tag still serves as a marker for future visual implementation (out of scope per Phase 6 task spec).

events.notes:
New file Assets/Scripts/Core/Commands/CommandTypes/ConvertSegmentToGateCommand.cs (109 lines): ConvertSegmentToGateCommand struct (marker for symmetry) + ConvertSegmentToGateCommandHelper.Execute(em, segment, focusInstance) static method. Canonical 80-supplies flat cost (Cost ConversionCost) + 8-second duration (const float ConversionDuration). Helper guards: em.Exists(segment) + HasComponent<WallSegmentTag> + HasBuffer<WallInstanceRef> + idempotent check via HasComponent<WallSegmentUpgradeState> + FactionEconomy.Spend. Sets WallSegmentFocus { Instance } on the segment so PickGateRegionInstances (Phase 5) lands on the player's clicked instance, then AddComponentData WallSegmentUpgradeState { UpgradeType=2, FocusInstance, Total=8, Remaining=8 }.

CommandRouter.cs: IssueConvertSegmentToGate(em, segment, focusInstance, source) — guard triad (em.Exists + HasComponent<WallSegmentTag> + idempotent HasComponent<WallSegmentUpgradeState> + IsBlockedByNotControllable) + lockstep route vs direct execute. CommandRouter.LockstepQueue.cs: QueueConvertSegmentToGateForLockstep(em, segment, focusInstance) — segment-id rides in EntityNetworkId, focus-instance network-id in TargetEntityId (0 = no focus → fallback to midpoint on the executing peer). Gate drops out while the parent segment carries WallSegmentUpgradeState (mid-conversion). Tower reads cost from BuildCosts. HudBridge.cs: Two new inbound topic handlers — HandleConvertWallSegmentToGate (parses {segmentId, focusInstanceId}, resolves both via current selection by Entity.Index, applies ownership + affordability guards, routes through CommandRouter.IssueConvertSegmentToGate) and HandleWallPreviewGate (parses {segmentId, focusInstanceId, on}, walks WallInstanceParent to find segment, calls AlanthorWall.PickGateRegionInstances to find the 5 candidate instances, adds/removes WallInstancePreviewTag on each — pure presentation-only, no lockstep, no command). EmitSingle extended with a new 'wall' payload field {kind: 'instance' | 'converting', segmentId, focusInstanceId, segmentInstanceCount, gateWidth, shortSegment, remaining?, total?} emitted on ActionType.WallInstanceUpgrade.

HudFrontend Actions.jsx: ActionCell extended with onPointerEnter/onPointerLeave props (per-button hover dispatch). New 'wall' branch in ActionsGrid with the Gate / Tower cells + a mid-conversion progress display (spire glyph, 'Converting to Gate (Nx)', X.Xs remaining). deriveSelectionKey tests sel.wall before the building-name match. HudFrontend Selection.jsx: Added a SEGMENT sub-line (and a SHORT amber line when shortSegment is true) under the existing bars when sel.wall is present. Communicates the segment instance count + gate width visually.

events.description: Phase 7 / AD-12: SimpleAISystem audit confirmed it does NOT iterate or target walls anywhere — TryBuildBuilding selects from BuildOrderStep.Id (no wall ids in any AIBuildOrder), ChooseAttackTarget targets MinerTag/GathererHutTag/HallTag only, AssignIdleMiners targets IronMineTag/CadaverTag only, and TryFindBuildPosition reads BuildingTag positions for spacing (walls correctly act as spacing obstacles — exactly what we want). The architect's spec called for `if (em.HasComponent<WallHubTag>(building)) continue;` skip filters. Implementer chose a stronger defence-in-depth approach: an EXPLICIT string-id guard at the entry of TryBuildBuilding that rejects 'Alanthor_Wall', 'Alanthor_WallTower', 'Alanthor_WallGate' before reaching the placement pipeline. This catches the failure mode the architect was guarding against (a future buggy AIBuildOrder entry) at a higher level — the ECS WallHubTag check would only fire once the id resolved to an existing entity, which never happens in TryBuildBuilding. No HasComponent<WallHubTag>/WallSegmentTag/WallInstanceTag skip filter is needed in the BuildingTag spacing loop because spacing is the CORRECT behaviour for walls (they should block AI from placing on top of them).

Phase 7 / AD-13: Scenario seed for 5-wide gate moved from Blue side to Red side. The Blue wall in SpawnWallSiege has 5 hubs across 24m with hubSpacing=6m → each segment yields only 3 wall instances (ceil((6-1)/2)=3); PickGateRegionInstances would short-clamp to 3, not exercising the 5-wide path. The Red side has 2 hubs at x=±8m (16m apart) → 8 wall instances per segment, giving room for a true 5-wide centre region. Blue's centre 'Gate at center' remains as a legacy per-instance single-cell gate via UpgradeWallInstancesNear(upgradeType:2), preserving the IMGUI EntityActionPanel reference path for backward-compat verification. Net effect: SpawnWallSiege now exercises BOTH gate paths simultaneously — legacy 1-instance gate (Blue) and new 5-wide region (Red).

Phase 7 / AD-14: SeedFiveWideGateOnSegment helper mirrors WallUpgradeSystem.Loop2's archetype changes exactly but applies them eagerly (no timer, no faction-bank spend). Pattern: find segment via hub's WallHubLink buffer → PickGateRegionInstances with Entity.Null focus (segment-midpoint) → iterate the up-to-5 members and add WallGateTag + WallGateRegionTag + WallGateGroup{Leader = members[Length/2]} + WallGateState + swap PresentationId to 554. The eager path matches the scenario's instant-upgrade convention (UpgradeWallInstancesNear also bypasses the timer). PassabilityGrid integration: each instance loses its BuildingTag-driven block (PassabilityBuildingSync excludes WallGateTag entities at line 85) and gains WallGatePassabilitySystem's per-cell open/close cycle with the wider RegionDetectRadius=6.0 because of WallGateRegionTag.

Phase 7 / AD-15: NavMeshManager verification — NO change needed. NavMeshManager.RebuildBuildingSources (line 214) already skips WallGateTag entities from the navmesh stamp via `if (em.HasComponent<WallGateTag>(e)) continue;`. When Phase 5's WallUpgradeSystem.Loop2 (or the scenario seed) adds WallGateTag to an instance, the NEXT diff-detect pass treats the instance as 'removed from stamp' and the rebake triggers. This works correctly per-instance for the 5-wide region — each of the 5 members independently exits the stamp set on its WallGateTag add, and re-entry would only happen if the tag is removed (which never happens for region members in v1). PassabilityGrid integration likewise correct: PassabilityBuildingSync (line 85) excludes WallGateTag entities; WallGatePassabilitySystem owns Block/Unblock for the 5 cells.
